title: Inspect blanks in emissions coefficients
question: Which carbon monoxide coefficients are filled, blank or explicitly zero?
timestamp_note: Envelope retrieval timestamps use a fixed replay clock, not publisher retrieval times. Actual fixture capture times appear in the manifest; null means unrecorded.
answer: Among 39 technology rows, 18 CO coefficients are blank, 0 are explicitly zero, and 21 are nonzero.
limitations: A blank is not zero. Exception fields are retained but not resolved; this file gives no physical unit for the coefficients.

source_notes: Title: Emission coefficients for energy technology by sector
Description: may.be.historic is an indicator variable that indicates if the "new" technology may be been used historically by some sector.
